name: Game1K
description: Game1K is widely known online as one of MultiCraft's top players. Starting in 2021, he has actively contributed to the PvP community. He is also the creator of the original tier list system.

name: ioking
description: ioking brought hundreds of players together with his SMP series; Insane Survival (IS). He helped reshape PvP from 2020-2023 and put many players into the spotlight and to reach high rankings on PvP leaderboards from his server and the impact it made on the community.

name: IAMABID
description: Created DvR: the biggest PvP server series in history. He reshaped PvP, and inspired modern-day PvP servers. Reforming Diamond Kit to what it is today, and inspiring all PvPs worldwide.

name: Verxsion
description: A famous PvPer and YouTuber hitting over 1.4K subscribers, rumored by some people to be one of the best PvPers challenging Game1K, he's mainly known for scourge legacy and his 1v20s on RvM.

name: Vorthexis
description: A MultiCraft PvPer who is known for his editing and his PvP server known as PvP Empire, created in early 2025, in his prime, he peaked as a HT2 Dragonhide KB player, known for his kindness and skills, he's easily a person to remember.

name: Cocoakyecorn
description: A popular builder, mainly known for his older server Hypnos based around PvP and Building. He peaked at 1.2K subscribers in his prime before practically leaving the community, but is remembered for his server and building.

name: TimmyLoal
description: TimmyLoal is an exceptionally popular MultiCraft PvPer and the founder of MVER, a MultiCraft editing leaderboard and ranking system. He climbed the leaderboards on both MTCTiers and MVER through his impressive skill in PvP and editing. Widely known for his Emerald gameplay, he peaked at LT1 in Emerald, a major achievement. In mid 2026, he retired from every kit except Emerald.
